outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap plots of cell-type deconvolution scores overlaid on tissue images; this is a heatmap-type visualization, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot with individual data points (dots for each spatial spot) overlaid on top of the box plots, satisfying the requirement.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment plots, which are line plots; overlaying individual data points on this plot type is not appropriate and is exempt.
Panel D is a bar chart displaying summary log2 fold-change values for each gene without any overlaid individual data points showing the underlying expression values/variability.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a quantitative plot, so this check does not apply.
